dialogues.speaker: Brook
dialogues.text: Haha, of course. This steak was made by me, Brook, after all!

dialogues.speaker: Brook
dialogues.text: I can say with confidence that I make the best steaks in Mondstadt.

dialogues.speaker: Brook
dialogues.text: Have you tried some before? If you haven't, you can get a sample now.

dialogues.speaker: Brook
dialogues.text: Don't be shy. This is flavor that will revolutionize your taste buds!
